payload.explanation: Diagnostic report (report_d019b167d303) shows the business request session_ad107989af75 is blocked on a transactionid lock held by session_3f52c9bb9ed1, which is idle in transaction after an uncommitted identical UPDATE on inventory product_id=1. State report (report_6300e7917346) confirms session_3f52c9bb9ed1 is project-owned, eligible for rollback_session, released=false, and the business request remains pending with stock unchanged at 100.
